Agent engineering and domain setup

goals.title: Slice 0 TDD project foundation
goals.objective:
Slice 0 TDD project foundation
Objective: Build only the Phaser/Vite/TypeScript foundation, scene flow, save/profile basics, mission registry, fake mission completion, and initial tests.
goals.evidence: Slice 0 foundation implemented: Phaser/Vite/TypeScript app, Boot->Preload->Start->Profile->TownMap->PlaceholderMission->MissionComplete flow, local profile save persistence, 3 placeholder missions, star save flow, baseline gamepad Input Intent, placeholder asset catalog. Verified npm test (13/13), npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm run dev HTTP 200, vite preview HTTP 200.

goals.title: Slice 1 TDD profile and town map loop
goals.objective:
Slice 1 TDD profile and town map loop
Objective: Build profile selection, parent settings, static town map, registry-driven mission nodes, and persisted fake completion progress.
goals.evidence: Slice 1 profile/map loop implemented: up to 5 local profiles with selection, parent settings behind 3-second hold gate, settings screen for mute/volume/difficulty/reset, registry-driven town map projection via TownMapProgress, persisted fake mission stars shown after reload path, scene route includes Start->Profile->TownMap->PlaceholderMission->MissionComplete plus settings. Verified npm test (18/18), npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm run dev HTTP 200.

goals.title: Slice 2 TDD Rivet's Recycling Run
goals.objective:
Slice 2 TDD Rivet's Recycling Run
Objective: Build the first real mini-game through tested item/category data, bin interaction, hints, scoring, and saved stars.
goals.evidence: Rivet's Recycling Run implemented as first real mini-game: recyclingItems data covers trash/paper/plastic/metal/compost; RecyclingRun module covers difficulty bins, item selection, no-fail retry hints, accuracy stars, and result stats; RecyclingRunScene provides large touch bin buttons plus keyboard/gamepad selection; TownMap routes recycling-run to real scene; MissionComplete persists best stars; asset backlog records runtime placeholder bins/items. Verified npm test (22/22), npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm run dev HTTP 200.

goals.title: Slice 3 TDD Brick's House Builder
goals.objective:
Slice 3 TDD Brick's House Builder
Objective: Build the construction sequence mini-game through tested blueprint data, part placement, hints, scoring, and sticker unlock.
goals.evidence: Brick's House Builder implemented: houseBlueprints define 3 houses with foundation->walls->roof->door->decoration order; HouseBuilder module covers wrong-piece no-fail hints, sequencing, 3-house completion, accuracy stars, and sticker unlock; HouseBuilderScene provides large touch part tray plus keyboard/gamepad selection and shape snap feedback; TownMap routes house-builder to real scene; MissionComplete persists sticker/star result; asset backlog records runtime placeholder house parts. Verified npm test (25/25), npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm run dev HTTP 200.

goals.title: Slice 4 TDD Ember's Fire Fix
goals.objective:
Slice 4 TDD Ember's Fire Fix
Objective: Build the movement/action mini-game through tested input intent, cartoon fire health, hose spray collision, helper assistance, and saved stars.
goals.evidence: Ember's Fire Fix implemented: picnicFires data defines 5 cartoon fires; FireFix module covers player movement, aim direction, spray collision, fire health shrink, helper drone assist, completion, and star result; FireFixScene provides touch movement buttons, Spray button, keyboard/gamepad movement/action/back, visual fire health and aim line; TownMap routes fire-fix to real scene; MissionComplete persists stars/sticker; asset backlog records runtime placeholder fire/water/hydrant needs. Verified npm test (29/29), npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm run dev HTTP 200.

goals.title: Slice 5 polish, accessibility, audio, and deploy
goals.objective:
Slice 5 polish, accessibility, audio, and deploy
Objective: Add toy-feel polish, audio/mute, celebration FX, accessibility pass, mobile layout smoke checks, and static deployment.
goals.evidence: Slice 5 polish implemented: AudioSystem effective mute/volume settings and theme-loop backlog status; accessibility rules for target size/no harsh failure/helper-mode; non-flashing celebration plan and MissionComplete confetti/stars; fade-in scene transitions; manual GitHub Pages workflow and docs; mobile landscape smoke checklist. Verified npm test (14 files, 37 tests), npm run typecheck, npm run build, GITHUB_PAGES=true npm run build, npm run dev HTTP 200, git diff --check.

goals.title: Post-MVP expansion gate
goals.objective:
Post-MVP expansion gate
Objective: Reassess code architecture, play-test evidence, asset state, and fun before adding roadmap missions after the first three are solid.
goals.evidence: Post-MVP expansion gate completed: ADR-0006, post-MVP gate review, play-test guide, issue #9, asset intake updates, SceneNavigation seam, CI post-MVP gate, pure gate validator with negative tests, local-storage read/write/remove fail-safes, final cleanup report, and final independent reviews. Verified npm run check:post-mvp-gate, npm test (16 files, 55 tests), npm run typecheck, npm run build, GITHUB_PAGES=true npm run build, npm run dev HTTP 200, git diff --check, npm audit --audit-level=high 0 vulnerabilities. Quality gate clean: ai-slop-cleaner passed, code-reviewer APPROVE, architect CLEAR with independentReview evidence.
